garratt_start.description: This audio file, 3 minutes 23 seconds in length, conveys the sound of an articulated narrow-gauge 400 class "Beyer-Garratt" steam locomotive of the South Australian Railways at close quarters starting off, then its train of ore-carrying gondola cars predominating, then the sounds of the hard-working locomotive reverberating in the distance. wws_p8.title: WWS PrussianpassengersteamlocomotiveP-8.ogg
wws_p8.author: Work With Sounds / Konrad Gutkowski
wws_p8.description: The prussian passenger steam locomotive P-8 (production series 38 2267) with tender was built by the Berliner Maschinenbau AG in 1918. Up until the Second World War it had been on duty for the Reichsbahn Directorate of Erfurt. After the Second World War the locomotive carried passengers and freight in Saxony until the 1970s.
